lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa kaaraj sach naam suhelaa bin sabadai kaaraj kehaa he ||7||
lines.translation: Through the True Name, one's actions are forever embellished. Without the Shabad, what can anyone do? ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਸੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi hasai khin mahi rovai ||
lines.translation: One instant, he laughs, and the next instant, he cries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojee duramat kaaraj na hovai ||
lines.translation: Because of duality and evil-mindedness, his affairs are not resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog karatai likh paae kirat na chalai chalaahaa he ||8||
lines.translation: Union and separation are pre-ordained by the Creator. Actions already committed cannot be taken back. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat gurasabad kamaae ||
lines.translation: One who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siu sad hee rahai samaae ||
lines.translation: He remains forever immersed in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te milai vadiaaee haumai rog na taahaa he ||9||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he is not afflicted by the disease of egotism. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras kas khaae pi(n)d vadhaae ||
lines.translation: Eating tasty delicacies, he fattens up his body

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekh karai gurasabad na kamaae ||
lines.translation: and wears religious robes, but he does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar rog mahaa dukh bhaaree bisataa maahi samaahaa he ||10||
lines.translation: Deep with the nucleus of his being is the great disease; he suffers terrible pain, and eventually sinks into the manure. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed paRahi paR baad vakhaanahi ||
lines.translation: He reads and studies the Vedas, and argues about them;

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat mahi braham tis sabad na pachhaanahi ||
lines.translation: God is within his own heart, but he does not recognize the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s tat bilovai rasanaa har ras taahaa he ||11||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh churns the essence of reality; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar vath chhodahi baahar dhaavahi ||
lines.translation: Those who forsake the object within their own hearts, wander outside.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe saad na paavahi ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not taste the flavor of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਫੀਕੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: an ras raatee rasanaa pheekee bole har ras mool na taahaa he ||12||
lines.translation: Imbued with the taste of another, their tongues speak tasteless, insipid words. They never taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh dehee bharam bhataaro ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh has doubt as his spouse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat marai nit hoi khuaaro ||
lines.translation: He dies of evil-mindedness, and suffers forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh man doojai laaiaa supanai sukh na taahaa he ||13||
lines.translation: His mind is attached to sexual desire, anger and duality, and he does not find peace, even in dreams. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)chan dehee sabad bhataaro ||
lines.translation: The body becomes golden, with the Word of the Shabad as its spouse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhog bhoge har siu piaaro ||
lines.translation: Night and day, enjoy the enjoyments, and be in love with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa a(n)dar gair mahal paae bhaanaa bujh samaahaa he ||14||
lines.translation: Deep within the mansion of the self, one finds the Lord, who transcends this mansion. Realizing His Will, we merge in Him. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape devai devanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver Himself gives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis aagai nahee kisai kaa chaaraa ||
lines.translation: No one has any power to stand against Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase sabad milaae tis daa sabad athaahaa he ||15||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives, and unites us with the Shabad; The Word of His Shabad is unfathomable. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh hai tis keraa ||
lines.translation: Body and soul, all belong to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib thaakur meraa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is my only Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gurabaanee har paaiaa har jap jaap samaahaa he ||16||5||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I have found the Lord. Chanting the Lord's Chant, I merge in Him. ||16||5||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naad bed beechaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad instead of the Vedas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh giaan dhiaan aapaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh attains infinite spiritual wisdom and meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh kaar kare prabh bhaavai guramukh pooraa paaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh acts in harmony with God's Will; the Gurmukh finds perfection. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh manooaa ulat paraavai ||
lines.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh turns away from the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh baanee naad vajaavai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh vibrates the Naad, the sound current of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sach rate bairaagee nij ghar vaasaa paaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh, attuned to the Truth, remains detached, and dwells in the home of the self deep within. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee saakhee a(n)mrit bhaakhee ||
lines.translation: I speak the Ambrosial Teachings of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabade sach subhaakhee ||
lines.translation: I lovingly chant the Truth, through the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach ra(n)g raataa man meraa sache sach samaaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: My mind remains forever imbued with the Love of the True Lord. I am immersed in the Truest of the True. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh man niramal sat sar naavai ||
lines.translation: Immaculate and pure is the mind of the Gurmukh, who bathes in the Pool of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mail na laagai sach samaavai ||
lines.translation: No filth attaches to him; he merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaavai sad hee sachee bhagat driRaaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sach bainee guramukh sach nainee ||
lines.translation: True is the speech of the Gurmukh; true are the eyes of the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sach kamaavai karanee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh practices and lives the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sad hee sach kahai din raatee avaraa sach kahaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: He speaks the Truth forever, day and night, and inspires others to speak the Truth. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sachee ootam baanee ||
lines.translation: True and exalted is the speech of the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sacho sach vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh speaks Truth, only Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sad sevahi sacho sachaa guramukh sabad sunaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh serves the Truest of the True forever; the Gurmukh proclaims the Word of the Shabad. ||6||
